title: GABA signaling in NG2 glia mediates empathy-like behavior under observational social defeat.
summary: Empathy, ranging from emotional contagion to consolation, is central to social cognition. While neural mechanisms of observed pain are well studied, how witnessing trauma affects empathy-related behaviors remains unclear. Using an observational social defeat (OSD) model, we find that OSD-exposed mice display enhanced allogrooming toward defeated conspecifics, indicating increased consolation behavior. Whole-brain cFos mapping and fiber photometry reveal selective activation of medial amygdala (MeA) GABAergic neurons during empathic allogrooming. NG2 glia modulate this behavior via GABA signaling; their specific ablation in the MeA reduces inhibitory synaptic transmission, disinhibiting neighboring GABAergic neurons and increasing allogrooming. Single-cell RNA analysis reveals that GABA signaling originates from Gad1-expressing NG2 glia. Genetic knockout of Gad1 in NG2 glia recapitulates the phenotype. This mechanism requires elevated corticosterone induced by social defeat. Our findings highlight the role of NG2 glia-GABA neuron interactions in promoting prosocial empathy and suggest targeting GABA signaling in NG2 glia as a potential therapeutic strategy for vicarious trauma.

标题：NG2神经胶质细胞中的GABA信号介导观察性社交失败下的共情样行为
摘要：共情，从情绪感染到安慰，是社会认知的核心。虽然观察疼痛的神经机制已被广泛研究，但目睹创伤如何影响共情相关行为仍不清楚。利用观察性社交失败（OSD）模型，我们发现在OSD条件下暴露的小鼠对受挫同伴表现出增强的异体梳理行为，表明安慰行为增加。全脑cFos图谱和光纤记录揭示，在共情异体梳理过程中，内侧杏仁核（MeA）中的GABA能神经元被选择性激活。NG2神经胶质细胞通过GABA信号调节这一行为；在MeA中特异性消融这些细胞会减少抑制性突触传递，从而去抑制邻近的GABA能神经元并增加异体梳理行为。单细胞RNA分析表明，GABA信号源自表达Gad1的NG2神经胶质细胞。在NG2神经胶质细胞中敲除Gad1基因可重现这一表型。该机制需要社交失败诱导的皮质酮水平升高。我们的发现强调了NG2神经胶质细胞- GABA神经元相互作用在促进亲社会共情中的作用，并提示靶向NG2神经胶质细胞中的GABA信号可能是治疗替代性创伤的潜在策略。
关键词：共情；NG2神经胶质细胞；GABA信号；内侧杏仁核；观察性社交失败

title: Reading ability in both deaf and hearing adults is linked to neural representations of abstract phonology derived from visual speech.
summary: Reading is central to academic and vocational success. Some deaf children face reading challenges due to limited access to spoken or signed language. Robust phonological representations are key to reading development in hearing children. Spoken language phonology may be one of many contributors to reading development in deaf children. Indeed, speechreading ability correlates with reading skill in both deaf and hearing individuals, suggesting it is linked to reading development regardless of hearing status. Further support for this hypothesis would be provided by evidence that similar neural representations of speech phonology are evoked by visual speech and other language forms (auditory speech and text) and that these neural representations are related to reading proficiency. We used fMRI and representational similarity analysis (RSA) to identify shared neural representations of spoken language phonological structure. A group of deaf adult participants (N = 22), with a mixture of sign language and spoken language backgrounds and reading abilities, were presented with single lexical items as visual speech and dynamic text (cursive text, revealed letter-by-letter to promote a phonological reading strategy). Adult hearing participants (N = 25) were presented with the same words, but as visual speech and auditory speech. Shared neural representations of phonological structure of English words were found in each group in the superior and middle temporal cortex (STC/MTC) and these abstract representations were more similar across different language forms in better readers. Our data provide neurobiological evidence of the contribution of visual speech to abstract phonological representations of spoken language, that relate to reading proficiency, in both deaf and hearing adults.

标题：聋人和听力正常成人的阅读能力与源于视觉言语的抽象音韵神经表征相关

摘要：阅读能力是学业和职业成功的关键。部分聋儿因无法充分接触口语或手语而面临阅读困难。稳固的音韵表征是听力正常儿童阅读发展的关键因素。口语的音韵系统可能仅是聋儿阅读发展的众多促进因素之一。事实上，无论听力状况如何，唇读能力与聋人和听力正常个体的阅读技能均存在相关性，表明其与阅读发展相关联。若视觉言语与其他语言形式（听觉言语和文本）能诱发相似的言语音韵神经表征，且这些神经表征与阅读熟练度相关，将为上述假说提供进一步证据。本研究采用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和表征相似性分析（RSA），识别口语音韵结构的共享神经表征。一组聋人成年被试（N=22，包含手语和口语背景混合、阅读能力各异）通过视觉言语和动态文本（逐字母呈现的草书文本，以促进音韵阅读策略）接收单一词汇项目。听力正常成年被试（N=25）则以视觉言语和听觉言语形式呈现相同词汇。两组被试的颞上回/颞中回（STC/MTC）均发现英语词汇音韵结构的共享神经表征，且阅读能力更强者在不同语言形式间这些抽象表征的相似性更高。本研究提供了神经生物学证据，表明视觉言语对口语抽象音韵表征的贡献，且该表征与聋人和听力正常成人的阅读熟练度相关。

关键词：阅读能力；音韵表征；视觉言语；功能性磁共振成像；聋人与听力正常人群

title: Impact of sex chromosomes and gonad type in stress susceptibility in corticostriatal brain regions.
summary: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is characterized by symptom heterogeneity and sex differences in prevalence. To gain insight into these sex differences, we utilized the subchronic variable stress paradigm (SCVS) in which female mice are susceptible, while males are behaviorally resilient. We used the Four Core Genotypes mice to differentiate between sex chromosome complement (XX vs. XY) and gonad type (ovaries vs. testes) in stress susceptibility, uncoupling these factors by removing the testes-determining SRY gene from the Y chromosome. Mice were subjected to SCVS followed by assays to assess anxiety-/depressive-like behaviors. Regardless of gonads, XX mice were stress susceptible, while XY mice were stress resilient, underscoring the importance of sex chromosome effects to sex differences in susceptibility to SCVS, independent of gonad type. We then performed RNA-sequencing of the prefrontal cortex (PFC) and nucleus accumbens (NAc). Consistent with human MDD and previous rodent SCVS findings, there was little overlap in genes altered by SCVS across sex. In stress susceptible XX mice, stress exposure altered pathways related to immune function, while in resilient XY mice, stress exposure altered pathways involved in neuronal function. There was brain region specificity to how sex chromosome complement and gonad type contributed to sex-specific stress effects. In the NAc, sex chromosome complement was the primary contributor to stress-induced gene expression, while in the PFC, both sex chromosome complement and gonad type contributed. These findings underscore a complex relationship between sex chromosome complement and gonadal factors in shaping stress vulnerability, partly through immune-related pathways.

标题：性染色体和性腺类型对皮质纹状体脑区应激易感性的影响
摘要：重度抑郁症（MDD）以症状异质性和患病率的性别差异为特征。为深入了解这些性别差异，我们利用亚慢性可变应激范式（SCVS），其中雌性小鼠易感，而雄性小鼠在行为上具有韧性。我们使用四种核心基因型小鼠，以区分性染色体组成（XX vs. XY）和性腺类型（卵巢 vs. 睾丸）在应激易感性中的作用，并通过从Y染色体中移除睾丸决定性基因SRY来解耦这些因素。小鼠接受SCVS后，进行焦虑/抑郁样行为评估。无论性腺类型如何，XX小鼠对应激易感，而XY小鼠对应激有韧性，这强调了性染色体效应在SCVS易感性性别差异中的重要性，且独立于性腺类型。随后，我们对前额叶皮层和伏隔核进行了RNA测序。与人类MDD和既往啮齿类SCVS研究结果一致，不同性别间SCVS改变的基因重叠很少。在应激易感的XX小鼠中，应激暴露改变了与免疫功能相关的通路；而在应激韧性的XY小鼠中，应激暴露改变了与神经元功能相关的通路。性染色体组成和性腺类型对性别特异性应激效应的贡献具有脑区特异性。在伏隔核中，性染色体组成是应激诱导基因表达的主要贡献者；而在前额叶皮层中，性染色体组成和性腺类型都有贡献。这些发现强调了性染色体组成与性腺因素在塑造应激脆弱性（部分通过免疫相关通路）中的复杂关系。
关键词：性别差异、应激易感性、性染色体、应激、情绪

title: Perceiving to Provide: How Partner Attachment Perceptions Inform Reassurance Provision in Romantic Relationships.
summary: Romantic partners can play a key role in buffering one another's attachment insecurities, but how they perceive one another's attachment and whether perceptions predict behavior remains unclear. This research examined how accurately individuals perceive their partner's global and relationship-specific attachment anxiety and avoidance, what biases shape these perceptions, and whether perceptions predict reassurance provision, a recommended buffering strategy for anxiously attached partners. Using the Truth and Bias Model, two studies (Study 1: N = 108 couples; Study 2: N = 147 couples) showed that individuals perceive their partner's attachment with moderate accuracy, though they also overestimate insecurity and are biased to assume both similarity and complementarity in attachment. Moreover, people who perceived their partners to be higher in attachment anxiety provided greater reassurance during personal stressor discussions and in daily life (10-day ecological momentary assessment), suggesting that attachment perceptions may play a key role in initiating and calibrating buffering strategies.

标题：感知以提供：伴侣依恋感知如何影响浪漫关系中的安慰提供  
摘要：浪漫伴侣在缓冲彼此的依恋不安全感中扮演关键角色，但伴侣如何感知对方的依恋以及这种感知是否预测行为仍不清楚。本研究考察了个体在多大程度上准确感知伴侣的整体性和关系特定性依恋焦虑与回避，哪些偏见塑造了这些感知，以及这些感知是否预测安慰提供——这是针对焦虑型依恋伴侣的一种推荐缓冲策略。采用真实与偏见模型，两项研究（研究1：108对情侣；研究2：147对情侣）表明，个体能以中等准确度感知伴侣的依恋，尽管他们也会高估不安全感，并倾向于假设依恋中的相似性和互补性。此外，感知到伴侣依恋焦虑更高的个体，在个人压力源讨论和日常生活中（为期10天的生态瞬时评估）提供了更多安慰，表明依恋感知可能在启动和调节缓冲策略中发挥关键作用。  
关键词：依恋感知；浪漫关系；安慰提供；依恋焦虑；社会认知

title: Large language models pass a standard three-party Turing test.
summary: The Turing test has been widely discussed as a test of machine intelligence, but it also provides a measure of how humans distinguish other humans from machines. We evaluated 4 systems (ELIZA, GPT-4o, LLaMa-3.1-405B, and GPT-4.5) in two randomized, controlled, and preregistered Turing tests on independent populations. Participants had 5 min conversations simultaneously with another human participant and one of these systems before judging which conversational partner they thought was human. When prompted to adopt a humanlike persona, GPT-4.5 was judged to be the human 73% of the time: significantly more often than interrogators selected the real human participant. LLaMa-3.1, with the same prompt, was judged to be the human 56% of the time-not significantly more or less often than the humans it was being compared to. Without these prompts, however, the same models performed significantly worse (38% and 36%), and did not consistently outperform baseline models, ELIZA and GPT-4o (23% and 21%, respectively). A third study replicated these results in 15-min games: two PERSONA-prompted models achieved pass rates of 56% and 59%. The results constitute empirical evidence that artificial systems can pass a standard three-party Turing test. Interrogators' reasoning focused more on stylistic and socio-emotional aspects of human behavior rather than more traditional notions of intelligence. The results have implications for debates about what kind of intelligence is exhibited by large language models, the social impacts these systems are likely to have, and the aspects of human behavior that people continue to see as unique.

标题：大型语言模型通过标准三方图灵测试  
摘要：图灵测试被广泛讨论为衡量机器智能的测试，但它也提供了一种衡量人类如何区分其他人类与机器的方法。我们在独立人群中进行了两项随机、对照且预先注册的图灵测试，评估了四个系统（ELIZA、GPT-4o、LLaMa-3.1-405B和GPT-4.5）。参与者与另一位人类参与者及其中一个系统同时进行五分钟对话，然后判断他们认为哪个对话伙伴是人类。当被提示采用拟人化角色时，GPT-4.5在73%的情况下被判断为人类：这一比例显著高于审讯者选择真实人类参与者的比例。使用相同提示的LLaMa-3.1在56%的情况下被判断为人类，与其比较的人类相比，差异不显著。然而，在没有这些提示的情况下，相同模型的表现显著较差（38%和36%），且未能持续优于基线模型ELIZA和GPT-4o（分别为23%和21%）。第三项研究在15分钟的游戏情境中复制了这些结果：两个采用拟人化提示的模型达到了56%和59%的通过率。这些结果构成了人工系统能够通过标准三方图灵测试的实证证据。审讯者的推理更侧重于人类行为的风格和社会情感方面，而非传统的智力概念。这些结果对关于大型语言模型展现何种智能、这些系统可能产生的社会影响以及人们仍视为独特的人类行为方面等争论具有启示意义。  
关键词：图灵测试；大型语言模型；社会认知；情感；拟人化

title: Decisional reference point pathology: A cognitive mechanism for and a correlate of major depressive disorder in humans.
summary: The decisional reference point, the central mechanism underlying behavioral economics, conditions our evaluations of all reinforcers. Whether a given event is experienced as positive or negative depends on this reference point. A pathological elevation of the reference point would lead a person to experience once pleasurable activities as negative reinforcers. Thus, it has been hypothesized that a reference point pathology may play a critical role in the symptomology of major depressive disorder (MDD). Here, we test the hypothesis that the reference point is pathologically elevated and dynamically inflexible in patients suffering with MDD compared to healthy controls. We find that depression is associated with a significant elevation of the reference point, and the magnitude of this elevation correlates with disease severity. The ability of patients with MDD to dynamically adjust their reference point to the environment is also dysfunctional. Our findings link the previously demonstrated treatment of depression by deep brain stimulation to modulation of the reference point in the anterior cingulate cortex and identify pathology in the dynamics of reference point setting as a potential cognitive mechanism in the disorder. Finally, these results reveal that a three-minute video game-like task measuring the reference point strongly correlates with depression severity. After further testing for clinical validity, this rapid assay may serve as a potential tool for assessing and monitoring depression.

标题：决策参考点病理：人类重度抑郁症的认知机制及其相关因素
摘要：决策参考点是行为经济学的核心机制，决定了我们对所有强化物的评估。一个事件被体验为积极还是消极，取决于这一参考点。参考点的病理性提高会导致个体将曾经令人愉悦的活动体验为负强化物。因此，有假设认为参考点病理可能在重度抑郁症的症状学中发挥关键作用。在此，我们检验了假设：与健康对照组相比，抑郁症患者的参考点存在病理性升高且动态缺乏灵活性。我们发现，抑郁症与参考点的显著升高相关，且升高的程度与疾病严重程度相关。抑郁症患者动态调整参考点以适应环境的能力也存在功能障碍。我们的研究结果将先前证明的深部脑刺激治疗抑郁症与前扣带回皮层参考点的调节联系起来，并指出参考点设定的动态病理可能是该障碍的一种认知机制。最后，这些结果揭示，一项测量参考点的三分钟视频游戏式任务与抑郁症严重程度密切相关。在经过进一步的临床有效性测试后，这一快速评估方法可能成为评估和监测抑郁症的潜在工具。
关键词：决策参考点；重度抑郁症；认知机制；动态调整；深部脑刺激

title: Neural representations of popularity and leadership status relate to conformity in daily life.
summary: Individuals are motivated to increase their social status. To succeed in this pursuit, people must track information about others in their social sphere, monitor group norms, and adjust their behavior strategically. This study employed functional MRI and ecological momentary assessment methods in a sample of 92 college students belonging to 9 social groups to elucidate the neural mechanisms underlying these processes and their relationship to conformity in the context of alcohol use. When young adults passively looked at faces of their real-life social group peers, brain systems implicated in valuation and social cognition spontaneously tracked information about the popularity and leadership status of the social targets in an interdependent manner. Individual differences in these neural valuations were systematically associated with varying levels of conformity. Students who had stronger responses to faces of peers with relatively higher popularity and leadership status than themselves in one key valuation brain region, the ventromedial prefrontal cortex (vmPFC), were more likely to align their drinking behavior with their groups' norms in everyday life. These results provide evidence for how brain systems involved in valuation and social cognition flexibly track information about peers' popularity and leadership status in real-life social groups and contribute to a growing literature on the neural mechanisms through which social comparison processes shape conformity. Our study highlights the vmPFC as a central hub that spontaneously tracks status differences between the self and peers and uses this information to guide behavior to match group norms.

标题：日常生活中的受欢迎程度与领导地位的神经表征及其与从众行为的关系

摘要：个体有动机提升自己的社会地位。为了在这一追求中取得成功，人们必须追踪社会圈中他人的信息、监测群体规范，并策略性地调整自身行为。本研究对属于9个社会群体的92名大学生样本采用了功能性磁共振成像和生态瞬时评估方法，以阐明这些过程背后的神经机制，及其在饮酒情境中与从众行为的关系。当年轻人被动观看现实生活中社会群体同伴的面孔时，大脑中涉及价值评估和社会认知的系统会以相互依赖的方式自发追踪社会目标的受欢迎程度和领导地位信息。这些神经评估的个体差异与不同程度的从众行为系统性地关联。在关键的脑区——腹内侧前额叶皮层，对那些相对于自身具有更高受欢迎程度和领导地位的同伴面孔表现出更强反应的参与者，在日常生活中更倾向于使自己的饮酒行为与群体规范一致。这些结果提供了证据，表明大脑中参与价值评估和社会认知的系统如何在真实社会群体中灵活追踪同伴受欢迎程度和领导地位的信息，并丰富了关于社会比较过程如何塑造从众行为的神经机制的文献。我们的研究强调了腹内侧前额叶皮层作为中枢枢纽，能够自发追踪自我与同伴之间的地位差异，并利用这些信息引导行为以匹配群体规范。

关键词：神经表征；社会地位；从众行为；腹内侧前额叶皮层；生态瞬时评估

title: Human forebrain neural synchronization and entrainment to breathing during wakefulness, sleep, and external mechanical ventilation.
summary: The ability of the forebrain to track and integrate respiratory signals, a process known as breathing interoception, is critical for detecting respiratory threats and ensuring survival, yet its neural mechanisms remain largely unknown. Using human intracranial recordings, we identified widespread synchronization between forebrain neural oscillations and breathing rhythms across wakefulness, sleep, and external mechanical ventilation. During wakefulness, localized sites within known interoceptive regions such as insula, somatosensory cortex, anterior cingulate cortex, and amygdala robustly synchronized with breathing, highlighting their critical roles in breathing interoception. During sleep, forebrain synchronization with breathing decreased, while persisting in the amygdala and hippocampus, which may support vigilance and memory consolidation. In contrast to rodents, nasal airflow was not required for this synchronization, implicating multiple afferent pathways in respiratory interoception and possible unique evolutionary changes in humans. When breathing was driven by an external mechanical ventilator, the imposed breathing rhythm directly entrained forebrain activity, indicating a causal link. Notably, ventilator-driven slow, deep breathing entrained more forebrain sites, suggesting a potential mechanism through which breath-based practices might influence emotion and cognition. Together, these findings redefine breathing interoception as a pervasive influence within the forebrain, with implications for understanding disorders of respiratory awareness, emotional regulation, and cognitive health.

标题：人类前脑在清醒、睡眠和外部机械通气期间与呼吸的神经同步及夹带
摘要：前脑追踪并整合呼吸信号的能力（即呼吸内感受）对于检测呼吸威胁和确保生存至关重要，但其神经机制仍大多未知。通过使用人类颅内记录，我们识别出在清醒、睡眠和外部机械通气期间，前脑神经振荡与呼吸节律之间存在广泛的同步。清醒时，已知内感受区域（如脑岛、体感皮层、前扣带回皮层和杏仁核）内的局部位点与呼吸节律强同步，突出了它们在呼吸内感受中的关键作用。睡眠期间，前脑与呼吸的同步减少，但在杏仁核和海马体中持续存在，这可能支持警觉性和记忆巩固。与啮齿动物不同，这种同步不需要鼻气流，表明呼吸内感受涉及多种传入通路以及人类可能特有的进化变化。当呼吸由外部机械通气机驱动时，强加的呼吸节律直接夹带前脑活动，表明存在因果关系。值得注意的是，通气机驱动的缓慢深呼吸夹带了更多前脑位点，这表明基于呼吸的练习可能影响情绪和认知的潜在机制。总体而言，这些发现将呼吸内感受重新定义为前脑中的广泛影响因素，对理解呼吸意识障碍、情绪调节和认知健康具有重要意义。
关键词：呼吸内感受；前脑神经同步；情绪调节；认知健康；机械通气
